evaluation.implementation: local causal likelihood scorer; prompt rules reviewed against installed lm_eval 0.4.13
evaluation.sample_selection: sorted random.Random(1729).sample(range(N), count), reset RNG per task
evaluation.wikitext_join: two newlines between every raw row, including empty rows; tokenize without BOS/EOS; nonoverlapping complete windows; discard final incomplete window
evaluation.acc_norm_denominator: Unicode character count of answer text, excluding added leading space
evaluation.continuation_encoding: tokenize context+space+answer jointly; require tokenized context to be an exact prefix; fail rather than silently move boundary
evaluation.causality: router may inspect context only; one profile reused for all options; WT2 router sees first 128 tokens and only remaining 384 tokens are scored
evaluation.routing_probe: fixed8 block hidden features from a context-only prepass, if adaptive; explicitly account for extra pass without claiming speed or memory savings

quantization.format: signed int8 two's-complement with FP32 absmax scales per row and contiguous input group
quantization.lower_reconstruction: s=8-b; ((q.int16 >> s).float * 2**s + (2**s-1)/2) * scale; cast to FP16; s=0 exactly q*scale
quantization.modules: all seven Linear weights per layer: attention q/k/v/o and FFN gate/up/down
quantization.excluded: embeddings, lm_head, norms, biases stay FP16
quantization.compute: dequantized FP16 torch linear; not an integer kernel or claimed physical low-bit GPU footprint

gates.repeatability: two fresh processes per fixed mode on identical complete frozen sample set; identical predictions; abs mean_nll delta <= 1e-5; max per-choice summed logprob delta <= 1e-3
gates.baseline_sanity: all outputs finite; FP16 acc_norm > 0.30 on both MC tasks; fixed8 abs acc_norm delta <= 0.08 and perplexity ratio 0.8..1.25 vs FP16; fixed4 acc_norm > 0.25 and perplexity ratio 0.5..3 vs FP16
gates.baseline_failure: pause with exact mismatch; no router training or threshold relaxation
gates.integration: every integrated full-width tensor torch.equal to independent fixed8 reference; q/scales reload exact; model logits differ at4 and6 vs8; independent attention/FFN selection tested
gates.router_attempt_policy: declare exact train/dev splits, features, loss, and three attempts after baseline/integration gates but before any router fit; revise only on dev collapse, never final scores
gates.matched_budget: adaptive, random, static exactly 12 blocks each of4/6/8 within each of36 attention and36 FFN blocks per query; report block and parameter-weighted bits including FP16 exclusions separately; fixed4/8 are endpoints, not equal-cost comparators
gates.adaptive_success: paired bootstrap 95% CI for adaptive-minus-static WT2 mean_nll entirely below0, neither MC acc_norm regresses by more than0.02; report all other deltas and CIs; otherwise stop with negative or inconclusive result without more search
